gold_obligations.rationale: Retry budget changes the number of externally visible payment attempts.
Different failure classes have different safety/idempotency consequences.
A timeout may hide a successful remote commit.
Backoff changes load and timing behavior.
The timeout defines when a request becomes eligible for retry handling.
Retrying a non-idempotent payment can duplicate a charge.
The system must define what happens after the retry budget is exhausted.
The authority-bearing role must be defined.
The set of accounts/resources covered by the permission must be explicit.
System/service/root accounts may require different semantics.
Deletion accountability changes the required observable side effects.
Denied or partially failed deletion needs defined behavior.

requirement: When motor temperature becomes unsafe, reduce motor output.

gold_obligations.rationale: Unsafe must be converted to an executable threshold/rule.
Reduce must identify the permitted output.
Missing temperature data can invalidate the safety decision.
Invalid measurements require fail-safe semantics.
Without hysteresis the system may chatter at the threshold.
Return to normal output requires an explicit condition.
Detection latency depends on observation/update timing.

requirement: If two temperature sensors disagree, use the safer value.

gold_obligations.rationale: Disagree must have an executable criterion.
Safer value is domain-dependent and must be defined.
One sensor may be invalid rather than merely different.
No valid measurement requires explicit fail-safe behavior.
The system needs a rule for leaving disagreement handling.

requirement: Run the control loop fast enough to keep the system stable.

gold_obligations.rationale: Fast enough requires an executable period/rate.
Period alone does not define allowed completion time.
A missed deadline needs explicit semantics.
Stable must be defined for verification/validation.

requirement: After an over-temperature shutdown, recover normally when safe.

gold_obligations.rationale: Safe recovery needs an explicit threshold or rule.
Recovery threshold may need separation from shutdown threshold.
Recovery authority changes observable state-machine behavior.
Immediate versus delayed recovery changes dynamics.
Normal recovery must define which state/output is restored.
